Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses Activity-Based Protein Profiling (ABPP) with a ubiquitin-based probe (HA-Ub-PA) to enrich for deubiquitinating enzymes (DUBs). While the probe is a ubiquitin-derivative, it is used for affinity purification of the enzyme rather than mapping ubiquitination sites on substrates, but it aligns with the mod_ubiquitin/mod_ap_ms logic for routing. HDX-MS was also performed but the primary quantitative proteomics used DIA.

scope: HA-Ub-PA-bound DUBs were immunoprecipitated overnight at 4 °C with end-over-end rotation using 150 μL of anti-HA agarose slurry.
HA-Ub-PA DUB complexes were eluted with 2x Laemmli buffer, reduced, alkylated, and cleaned up for LC–MS/MS using S-Trap micro columns.
Immunoprecipitation of the HA tag on the HA-Ub-PA allows for DUB-ABP complexes to be purified and quantified by LC–MS/MS.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis (ABPP-MS) was performed on DUB complexes affinity-purified via immunoprecipitation from SH-SY5Y cell lysates. While the protein of interest (USP30) is mitochondrial, the material analyzed by MS was the purified complex, not a mitochondrial fraction.
